run_benchmark_generated_cpp: run the benchmark script to measure compilation time and memory for generated C++ source files
run_benchmark_with_custom_compiler: run the benchmark using clang instead of g++ with a custom repeat count of 10
run_benchmark_with_custom_include_dirs: run the benchmark pointing to a custom include directory and boost headers path
benchmark_single_file: benchmark a single C++ file by calling benchmark_file with a compiler and include directories
plot_compilation_diagrams: plot compilation time and memory usage diagrams from benchmark results into PNG images
